name: mercado-pos-colombia
description: Esqueleto de un punto de venta para Colombia

scripts.dev:pos: npm run build:packages && npm run start --workspace @mercado-pos/pos
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @mercado-pos/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @mercado-pos/pos
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @mercado-pos/contracts && npm run build --workspace @mercado-pos/domain
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @mercado-pos/api && npm run build --workspace @mercado-pos/pos
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test
